description: This Dart source file defines the ChatServiceFactory class, which creates instances of ChatService implementations (OpenAIChatService or MockChatService) based on available API keys. It chooses the appropriate service depending on whether an in-app stored key, build-time environment key, or none is available.

classes.name: ChatServiceFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating ChatService instances based on API keys.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a ChatService instance, prioritizing in-app stored key, then build-time key, and falling back to a mock service.
